sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Aga for the State and perused the record.

2.  The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioner for the following reliefs:-
"(i) Issue writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents to conclude the fair and proper investigation arising out of Case Crime No.0147 of 2025,, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC and Section 66-D of Information Technology Act, 2008, Police Station NOIDA Sector-39, District Gautam Buddh Nagar.

entities.text: Police Station NOIDA Sector-39, District Gautam Buddh Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: (ii) Any other writ, order or direction which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case.

(iii) tTo award the cost of the petition in favour of the petitioner."
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is the first informant in the present case and though, the F.I.R. in the instant case has been registered on 19.03.2025, yet the police is not investigating the case in fair and impartial manner.

4. In view of the above, the petitioner may move an application before the respondent no.2/Commissioner of Police, Commissionerate, Gautam Buddh Nagar, highlighting his grievance and seeking fair and impartial investigation and if such an application is moved by the petitioner,
respondent no.2/Commissioner of Police, Commissionerate, Gautam Buddh Nagar, shall ensure the fair, impartial and expeditious investigation in the present case.

entities.text: Commissioner of Police, Commissionerate, Gautam Buddh Nagar
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: 5. With the aforesaid order, the present writ petition stands disposed of.
